errors.evidence: The chart displays five categories within the "random layers" group (the green bars): "random layers", "random layers +B₂", "random layers +L₂", "random layers +R₂", and "random layers +permute". The description incorrectly states there are seven.
The description fails to mention that for each category on the x-axis, there is a pair of bars (one light-colored and one dark-colored). This is a fundamental structural feature of the chart.

errors.text_span: light blue bars represent the “embedding” and “1st layer” probes; light green bars represent “random layers” models with pre-trained embedding layers; red bars represent “random” models with random embedding layers; and orange bars represent the “unperturbed” models.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps colors to categories by mentioning only one shade (e.g., "light blue bars") or a general color ("red bars"), when each category group actually contains both a light and a dark shade bar. For example, the "embedding" and "1st layer" groups contain both light blue and dark blue bars.

errors.text_span: The “embedding” and “1st layer” bars (blue) show accuracies of approximately 80 and 82, respectively.
errors.evidence: This statement assigns a single approximate value to the "embedding" category and the "1st layer" category, each of which has two bars with distinct values. For "embedding", the bars are at approximately 80 and 82, so summarizing the entire category as just "80" is misleading.

errors.text_span: with values ranging from approximately 79.5 to 81
errors.evidence: The values for the "random layers" group of bars (green bars) range from approximately 79.5 (light bars) up to approximately 82 (the dark bar for the first "random layers" category). The stated upper bound of 81 is incorrect.
